title: 1 retries of jobs whose class does not exist
evidence: IdentifyPotentialDuplicatesJob x1 — purge via Sidekiq::RetrySet (only entries whose klass resolves to no constant)

notes.note: ROOT CAUSE: config/initializers/sidekiq.rb set no redis url, so the Sidekiq 7 worker defaulted to redis://localhost:6379/0 — crawlr's DB. This worker therefore consumed crawlr's 'default' queue and raised NameError on crawlr classes (TouchNeighborsJob x127, RecalculateCollectionCentroidJob x60, IdentifyPotentialDuplicatesJob, ActiveStorage::AnalyzeJob for crawlr blobs) from 16:02Z until 17:23Z. The earlier 'purge the retry set' response treated a symptom and it recurred. FIX: redis DB isolation in the initializer (server AND client -> /1, committed) plus .env REDIS_URL; probe check_zombie_jobs now classifies classes absent from the repo as FOREIGN-queue contamination and points at REDIS_URL isolation instead of the retry set. VERIFIED: journalctl -u turbo-carnival-sidekiq has 0 foreign-class executions since 17:23Z (worker restarted 13:23 EDT, pid 1960691, connections confirmed on DB 1 via redis MONITOR); probe re-run -> 0 warn; crawlr-sidekiq still consuming its own DB 0 queue normally.
